title: Compiled regex replace on ArrowDtype string and Categorical columns
answers: Why does Series.replace ignore re.compile patterns on Arrow string dtypes?
DataFrame.replace silently discards compiled regex on arrow-backed columns
How does Block._replace_regex validate string dtypes for compiled regexes?
Series replace with compiled regex is a no-op on pyarrow string
body:
Symptom: Series.replace or DataFrame.replace silently discards a compiled re.Pattern and returns unmodified data on ArrowDtype strings (pa.string(), pa.large_string()) or Categoricals of arrow strings.
Root cause: pandas/core/internals/blocks.py:Block._replace_regex gated is_re(to_replace) against a hardcoded list of dtypes [object, "string"], skipping execution for ArrowDtype strings while string regex patterns bypassed the check.
Fix pattern: Check regex applicability using is_string_dtype(target_dtype) and target_dtype.kind != "S", where target_dtype = _regex_target_dtype(self.dtype), admitting string extension dtypes and Categorical category dtypes while excluding byte strings.
Constraints: Applies to string ArrowDtype and Categoricals of arrow strings; does not support pa.string_view() or dictionary-encoded arrow strings, and numpy byte strings (kind == "S") remain excluded as regexes cannot match bytes.
applies: pandas Series and DataFrame regex replacement on blocks with ArrowDtype string dtypes or Categoricals
